description.en: View tab manager for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI session header: enable, hide, reorder and rename the conversation view tabs (Chat / Trajectory), with locale-aware zh/en UI and npm update reminders.
description.zh: DSH 视图标签管理器（逃咪）：管理会话页头视图标签（对话/轨迹）——启停、隐藏、排序与重命名，界面随语言中英切换，带 npm 更新提醒。
